Alex Rivera

Independent typeface designer, based in Lisbon.

Selected work

Between 2019 and 2024 I drew six typefaces for independent publishers, including a serif family commissioned by a small Portuguese press for a poetry anthology that took eleven months to set.

Process notes

I still cut proofs on paper before touching a screen. It slows the work down in a way I've come to depend on.
